text.b: SCHOOL LIFE AND THE WORLD AROUND US

text.i: Tell a friend about Nadine’s daily routine and then write about it. Use the prompts given.
Henry Glotter is a new magician. He is studying at a magician’s school. Henry is writing a letter to
his friend Ben, telling him about his life at school. Read Henry’s letter and do the exercises:
Complete the letter using: prepare, wakes, finish, broomstick, use, start, best, have.
Hi, Ben,
This is my life in my new school at Zabwards. Every morning Balloo, my owl,
……………….. me up at 8:00 o’clock. We …………..……… breakfast in the blue dining hall
at 9:00. Lessons ………………… at 9:30 a.m. and …………. at 2:00 p.m. My favourite
class is with Mr Higgins at the lab. We ………………….. magic potions and do spells.
I don’t know how to ………………… my magic wand yet but I try. In the afternoon I
play with my friends Rob and Hermina. They are my ………………….. friends. I like my
new school a lot and I’m proud of my ………………….. .
Henry.
Complete Henry’s routine at Zabwards:
Two pupils, one of them new, meet in the schoolyard. Complete the dialogue:

page.text: Simon: Yes, I like this school. It’s great! I hated my old school!
Simon: Well, in the afternoons I usually play football in my neighbourhood..
Simon: Mm, as I’m new I haven’t made many friends yet.
Jim: Don’t worry you’ll make friends quickly …………………………………………….………….
Simon: Oh, yes. I’d love to play football with you and your friends this afternoon.
Jim: Great – see you after school!

text.i: Look at the train schedule and complete:

page.text: Mark is at the train station in Athens and he is asking the information office to help him out – the
girl behind the counter speaks English well. Write the correct answers.
1. What time does the first train to Halkida leave?
2. How much does it cost to go to Thessaloniki?
3. How many trains are there for Livadia every day?
4. How long does it take to go to Litochoro?
5. How much does it cost to go to Halkida?

text.i: Mark is now at the ticket office. Complete the dialogue:

page.text: - Excuse me, sir. When is the next train to Thessaloniki?
- And how much is the ticket?
- How long does it take to go there?
- Ok. I’d like two tickets to Thessaloniki, please.
- Here’s your change but hurry, the train is leaving in 5 minutes.
- Thank you very much. Bye bye.
